copy.tagline: 把 Slack 频道接入你的应用
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 你开发的应用需要 Slack 聊天功能
copy.tagline_en: Integrate Slack channels into your app
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need Slack chat in your app

howto.what: 把 Slack 适配器从 channels 分支复制进项目并注册、安装依赖、构建并跑一次注册测试,再引导你创建 Slack 应用、存入令牌并重启服务。之后机器人可在 Slack 频道与私信收发消息。
howto.when: 当你要给 NanoClaw 项目添加 Slack 频道集成时使用,通常在 /setup 流程中或之后运行;该技能每步都是幂等的,可以重复执行。

say.text: 帮我给这个项目加上 Slack 频道集成
say.note: 复制适配器、装依赖、构建并跑注册测试

say.text: Slack 用 Socket Mode 接入,不要公网地址
say.note: 会设置 SLACK_APP_TOKEN 并订阅机器人事件

say.text: 机器人能发消息但收不到我的回复,帮我查下

howto.what_en: Copies the Slack adapter from the channels branch into your project, registers it, installs the package and runs the registration test. It then guides Slack app setup and token storage; after a restart the bot can send and receive messages.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you want to add Slack channel integration to a NanoClaw project, typically during or after the /setup flow; every step is idempotent and safe to re-run.

say_en.text: Add Slack channel integration to this project
say_en.note: Copies the adapter, installs deps, builds and tests

say_en.text: Wire Slack with Socket Mode, no public URL
say_en.note: Sets SLACK_APP_TOKEN and subscribes bot events

say_en.text: The bot sends messages but my replies vanish
say_en.note: Checks event subscriptions and App Home settings
